why: I2 (by-number tx list) must fail on the forward branch; the switch branch writes its own SYS_NUMBER_2_TXS row, so a switch-final sequence is the negative control.
I1 must fail because the whole-plane scrub deletes the still-canonical ancestor A's hash->number row; a forward-only sequence never runs that scrub.
The same-height switch must go red on the cache-bound composition (S13); the cache-less composition (S3) reads the backend directly, so it must stay green.
